title: Ashfall
summary: January, Year 2. Fallout rain then ash. The mask, sealing the shelter, a husk at the truck, Lolo's notebook, Deshawn's cistern, Ames and the frostbitten hand at Meadows General, Boone's expired filters at the yard, Annie's atrium. Night: strangers at the sealed door, then the midnight mimic at the mail slot. Morning: Dale Henley facing his kitchen wall. Tight interiors, flashlight-only rooms, Hollows that keep a voice and no breath.

horror.notes: Survival horror: tight interiors (hallway 3 cells, Henley kitchen 3 cells, wards), dead lamps, 22 m sightlines in ash; max 2 Tallmen active; Hollows wake only in low visibility.
horror.binding: Spawns tagged ambush=true + lowVisibilityTrigger=true stay dormant (no AI tick, hidden) until the player is inside the ambush point radius AND visibility (ash, fog, darkness, flashlight off) is below environment.visibilityM, or the point's lightFlicker drops out. Hollows (assimilated_human / assimilated_animal) never render a breath plume; living NPCs always do (story assimilation.tells).
